tool_input.title: Fix Rhino 8 Panel Registration Like Speckle Connectors
tool_input.prompt: The compose 3dm plugin starts Rhino but no side panel appears. The panel registration uses #if NETFRAMEWORK guards and System.Windows.Forms.Panel which doesn't work properly with Rhino 8. Need to fix panel registration following Speckle's approach: use RhinoWindows.Controls.WpfElementHost, register panel in Command constructor with Eto.Drawing.Icon, and use PanelType.System. Also need to add RhinoWindows NuGet package.
